note: The one home of the Home numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Home, Dock and arrival) and its wireframes 01-home.svg to 01e-home-rest.svg. stateRule: home: the screen at rest, docked or away. arrival: from ✓ Open the bay until the last crate has opened (events.arrival), input held. report: from the arrival's end until the next press. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the others exist in all three

resident.arrival: the residents stop and face the column (right) until the report card shows
resident.props: per resident: mibi id, stage, painting or placeholder, waiting, seed; the face steps the walk

states.docked: the nest, then the sleeping mibi with you (sleeper)
states.away: the nest, then the Companion mark 16×24 at (576, 488)
states.none: the nest alone (no mibi with you)

composition: sprite: the mibi with you, or the Companion mark
sprite: knob on the living window's frame

beam.note: behind the opening crate, from the door's top to its foot: (712 + 96i, 84, 80, 72)

crateStates.sealed: the crate with its orange seal tag
crateStates.opening: the tag gone, the lid lifting (300 ms, events.arrival)

docked.lamp: needsYou while crates wait, else off
docked.crates: one sealed crate per consignment, at most three, left to right in the order they open

arrival.crates: opened ones open, the current one opening, the rest sealed

rack.arrival: a well whose pod is still travelling shows empty until the pod lands

states.docked: the Probe in its cradle, its plates whole or gone
states.away: the cradle empty, no plates, the lamp off; the slot unchanged

travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out
travel.note: the pods travel from the bay across the 8 px gap into the rack; nothing is scaled; a pod never leaves this rectangle

crateIn.when: the Companion docks with crates while Home shows, or Home is landed on from Idle by Dock; elsewhere the crates are simply in the bay when Home next shows

arrival.focus: the room; no ring; no key moves it

crate.do: the beam shows behind this crate; its seal tag breaks and the lid lifts (sealed → opening → open)
the ribbon shows this crate's words (it appears on the first crate and changes words on the next; a cut, no fade)
the counters tick this crate's materials (the top bar's own tick and flash)
each of the crate's pods travels to its well (regions.travel), in well order
the world turn jumps to the crate's turn (the top bar's tick)
the beam goes; the crate stays open and empty

probeMend.do: each mended plate seats, gone → whole, left to right

end.do: the ribbon goes, the crates go, the Bay settles (2 px, 200 ms), the residents walk again, the report card shows (state report)

steps.do: the knob settles from its lift; the ring goes
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to Idle

focus.room: the ring on nothing: no ring is drawn, ✓ does what needs the player (the notice), the room's point is roomAt's centre (512, 300)

primitives.order: ▲ and ▼ step through the list as written, skipping ids not in props.focus.targets; the ends stop, never a wrap; ◀ and ▶ take the group's own edges
primitives.nearestIn: the target of that group whose box centre is nearest the ring's row: |dy| × 4 + |dx| × 0.01, centre to centre (from the room, roomAt's centre); none in the group: the ring stays
primitives.nearestIn ahead: only the group's targets more than 6 px ahead in the key's direction, nearest by along + 2.2 × across; none: the ring stays

focus.held: while events.arrival or events.rest holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent
focus.report: while the report card shows, a key closes it and also does what it does: the pad moves the ring by this graph, ✓ follows the bottom line, ← only closes

resident.box: the resident's box where the face has stepped it; the sleeping mibi on the bed is one (bed.sleeper), with no lift

strings.bayClosed: closed while the Companion is away
